trap.label: if + will
trap.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay home.
trap.right: If it rains, I will stay home.
trap.why: Em português 'se chover, ficarei' usa futuro do subjuntivo; em inglês a oração com if fica no presente, e o resultado leva will.

mcq.q: If it rains, we ___ stay home.
I'll help you if you ___ me.

opts: If he will run, he'll win.

fix.wrong: If I will see him, I'll tell him.
fix.right: If I see him, I'll tell him.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “You study. You'll pass.” com if
Negativa: “If you hurry, you'll miss it.” (não se apressa)
rewrite.answer: If you don't hurry, you'll miss it.
